summary: Isolate #634 budget hydrate/charge under base_dir/budget for feature_media plan and feature/bug loop starts when budget_base_dir is omitted; ledger under base_dir/ledger for loop starts.
migration_impact: No downstream config change. Tests and callers that pass base_dir without budget_base_dir no longer write operator .agentic/budget/spend.json.
agent_notes: When starting feature_media, feature_loop, or bug_loop with an isolated base_dir, omit budget_base_dir to auto-use base_dir/budget (same pattern as design_validation #846).
